headline: We could not find a Google Maps card for Cookie Crunchers in Alpine. Searching the name brings up a Cookie Crunchers in Belgium.
summary: Cookie Crunchers bakes and ships cookies from Alpine, with seven flavors on cookiecrunchers.com starting at $14.99 and delivery the day after you order. The leftover is Google: on Google Maps, Cookie Crunchers and cookiecrunchers.com both lead to a business with the same name in Antwerp, Belgium, and Cookie Crunchers Alpine CA shows other bakeries and cookie shops. A local directory, Loving Life Alpine, lists you as Open 24 hours every day.

signals.note: On Google Maps we searched Cookie Crunchers Alpine CA, Cookie Crunchers, cookiecrunchers.com, (760) 791-4040, and 1425 Louise Dr. None turned up a card for your bakery. The name search opened a Cookie Crunchers in Antwerp, Belgium; the phone search returned nothing; the address showed a plain pin.
signals.next: Set up a free Google Business Profile. A delivery or service-area profile can show where you deliver without listing a home address.

signals.note: Your site does not print a phone number. MapQuest lists (760) 791-4040. Your Privacy Policy lists cookiecrunchers1@gmail.com.
signals.next: Show the phone or the inbox you want orders to come through on the site and on a Google card.

signals.note: Loving Life Alpine lists Cookie Crunchers as Open 24 hours, every day of the week. Your site says orders are "Delivered/Shipped the day after you order unless future date requested".
signals.next: Ask Loving Life Alpine to swap the hours for a line about ordering online, or the hours you take orders.

signals.note: Every flavor on your site has its own photo, and you link Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
signals.next: Reuse those cookie photos on a Google card once it is up.

signals.note: cookiecrunchers.com is live on Shopify with seven flavors, prices, online ordering, and a Privacy Policy updated July 9, 2026.
Your home page says "Bakery in San Diego, California", while your Privacy Policy and MapQuest list 1425 Louise Drive, Alpine. MapQuest also says cookies start at $12.99; your site shows $14.99.
signals.next: Mention Alpine on the site, and ask MapQuest to refresh its description.
